- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-hardhat-solidity/Dockerfile.app.j2:19-28 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "(check the repository .dockerignore)" hint is emitted only in the no-lockfile, no-`package.json` case, so a `.dockerignore` that strips `package.json` but keeps the lockfile gets no hint.
  WHY: The operator sees only npm's ENOENT error and has to find the `.dockerignore` cause independently.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-hardhat-solidity/tests/30_hardhat_test.sh.j2:33-43 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The precheck `docker compose exec -T` call has no timeout, unlike the watchdog-protected suite run.
  WHY: A hung daemon or container would block the step until the harness-level timeout. The suggested fix is `timeout 60`. Severity is NIT, with a note that the suite call would hang the same way.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-hardhat-solidity/Dockerfile.app.j2:else-branch | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: A project with no root `package.json` used to build without dependencies and now fails the image build (`exit 1`).
  WHY: This is an intended, documented behaviour change (PR body and changelog fragment), listed for awareness only. Severity is NIT.
- scripts/validation_harness_sandbox.sh:935-942 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `stage_addfile` wrapper shadows `out.addfile` on the instance and could be bypassed by other tarfile paths.
  WHY: The staged member count could become inaccurate if the tarfile implementation changes. Severity is NIT. Two other reviewers found that `TarFile.add` calls `self.addfile`, so the counter sees every member.
